## About
Joey Kokinda builds across AI agents, blockchain infrastructure, and full-stack
web/mobile apps. Currently studying Artificial Intelligence at Purdue
University (Aug 2024 – May 2027). Previously studied Robotics at Rochester
Institute of Technology (2023–2024).

## Skills
- Languages: Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C, Solidity, Rust
- Web3: Solana (Rust/Anchor), Hedera HCS, EVM, Foundry, ERC-8183, ERC-7715,
  Chainlink CRE, smart contracts, DeFi
- AI/Agents: agent design, agent-to-agent automation, Claude, GPT, computer
  vision, LLM tooling
- Full stack/infra: React, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Docker,
  Tailscale, Cloudflare, self-hosted infra (DappNode, BTC/XMR nodes)
